articles.title: Visa backs Open USD with new stablecoin platform as Circle faces fresh competition
articles.snippet: Visa launched a stablecoin platform that lets banks and fintechs issue, manage and settle digital dollars through its payments network.

articles.title: Crypto brokerage firm Alpaca raises $135 million for tokenized stock infrastructure
articles.snippet: The company has previously cleared or held in custody roughly 94% of tokenized U.S. equities and now holds over $1.5 billion in underlying stocks.

articles.title: Inside the high-stakes race to build an open financial system specifically for AI bots
articles.snippet: The newly-convened x402 Foundation is a neutral space where competitors and payment methods can work together to create an open standard for AI agentic commerce.

articles.title: Cantor and Securitize collaborate on blockchain-based IPOs
articles.snippet: The move creates a pathway for public companies to raise capital onchain and issue tokenized securities.

articles.title: Alpaca raises $135M to fund tokenized agent-first infrastructure
articles.snippet: The BNP-backed brokerage infrastructure provider is expanding into tokenized markets and AI-native financial services as both DeFi and TradFi companies pursue onchain business.
